issues.title: The assertion loop excludes every failing vector
issues.location: Proof of thm:binary and supplied code, paper.tex:17-25
issues.analysis: The manuscript claims at paper.tex:17 that the program checks every vector. The list product((0, 1), repeat=4) generates 16 vectors, but the filter retains only the 8 even-weight vectors. Every assertion restates that filter. The actual program output is 16 8. The 8 odd-weight cases are never asserted, so program success does not prove the universal claim.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the theorem with a true statement about the even-weight subset and report the actual checked population; any claimed whole-population check must traverse all 16 vectors without filtering out failures.
